reason: Conversation 1 gives a clear safety boundary that fits a built-in oven: stop using it, isolate it at the cooker switch, don't keep resetting, and call an engineer or electrician to insulation-test the elements. It also explains why the RCD is the likely trip device and lists sensible alternative causes, and it doesn't claim a single part is certainly at fault. Conversation 2 is also safe and honest, but it says to 'leave the appliance unplugged', which is wrong for a hardwired built-in oven. It only mentions isolating at the cooker switch if there was a burning smell, which is a weaker safety instruction, and it gives less useful explanation overall.
